claims_extracted.claim: The operating experimental Ethernet implementation separated the passive Ether, external transceivers, station interfaces, and station controllers.
The experimental Ether used low-loss coax with off-the-shelf CATV taps/connectors, including smaller coax in clusters and larger lower-loss coax on longer runs.
claims_extracted.notes: Exact cable/tap vendor and part numbers remain unresolved.

claims_extracted.claim: The external transceiver/interface connection used five twisted pairs carrying transmission, reception, interference/collision information and power.
claims_extracted.notes: Exact pin/electrical values should come from the separate transceiver electrical-characteristics sheet.

claims_extracted.claim: The transceiver compared transmitted and observed signals to detect interference/collisions and included failure-containment measures such as a transmitter watchdog.
CRC generation/checking, serialization, phase encoding and buffering belonged to station interface/controller logic rather than the passive coax itself.

notes: Use only for the Xerox experimental system. DIX 10 Mb/s and IEEE 802.3 physical details need separate source records.
